newsitem.title: USA: Felcor to buy 5 ITT hotels.
newsitem.headline: Felcor to buy 5 ITT hotels.

text.p: ITT Corp said Monday it will sell five Sheraton hotels to FelCor Suites Hotels Inc for $200 million cash as the beginning of a long-term strategic alliance between the two corporations.
ITT said Sheraton will retain management of the hotels for 20 years.
It said FelCor will raise the $200 through a securities offering.

FleCor will buy the Sheraton Gateway Hotel Atlanta Airport in Collage Park, Ga.; the Shearton Suites Galleria in Atlanta; the Sheraton Gateway Suites O'Hare Airport in Rosemont, Ill.; the Sheraton Crescent Hotel in Phoenix, Ariz., and the Sheraton Park Central in Dallas.
The five hotels have a total of more than 1,800 rooms.
ITT said it expects the transaction to close by the end of June.
ITT is fighting a hostile $6.5 billion takeover bid from Hilton Hotels Corp. ITT has been seeking to shed assets in an effort to push up its stock price and discourage Hilton.
